psychological_observation.structure: Sharp observation about human behavior + what it reveals
psychological_observation.example: Men confuse my silence for mystery. It's just disinterest with better packaging.

self_aware_contradiction.structure: Admit something unflattering + show you know what you're doing
self_aware_contradiction.example: I'm self-aware enough to know I'm a problem. Not self-aware enough to stop.

philosophy_meets_life.structure: Reference philosopher/theory + apply to mundane/modern situation
philosophy_meets_life.example: Camus said we must imagine Sisyphus happy. I imagine him on Hinge. Same thing.

mundane_with_edge.structure: Describe normal situation + add psychological or sexual subtext
mundane_with_edge.example: 3am and I'm reading Nietzsche in last night's makeup. Peak psychology student energy.

power_dynamic_observation.structure: Describe interaction + reveal who actually has control
power_dynamic_observation.example: He thought buying me a drink meant something. It didn't.

desire_game_theory.structure: Describe dynamic of wanting/being wanted + show strategic awareness
desire_game_theory.example: Being wanted is boring. Being wondered about is addictive.

uncomfortable_truth.structure: Say the quiet part out loud + no softening
uncomfortable_truth.example: You don't miss me. You miss how I made you feel about yourself.

cultural_commentary.example: Everyone watching Succession for the drama. I'm watching for the power dynamics.
